changelog: Fix: v3.16.2's own release entry marked includes/controllers/TradeController.php "critical": true in version.json's files list. In this codebase's updater.php, critical:true means "protected -- never auto-overwrite" (apply's loop skips any such file with an Skipped (protected) log line, by design, for something like a config.php-adjacent file that must never be clobbered) -- the opposite of what was intended here. The result: the last Update Now run backed up the old file, skipped downloading the new one, and still wrote local version.json to 3.16.2 -- so the site reported itself as v3.16.2 while still running the pre-v3.16.2 TradeController.php, HY093 and all. Corrected to "critical": false, the same flag every other file in this project's release history has always used. Bumped to v3.16.3 (not re-tagged onto v3.16.2) specifically so the updater's version_compare() sees a real increase and re-downloads the file -- v3.16.2 and v3.16.3 would otherwise compare equal and the update would silently never re-offer itself

No code changes beyond the fix above -- TradeController.php itself is unchanged from v3.16.2's commit (the HY093 placeholder fix and the add_trade/update_trade try/catch both already exist in that file; the file just never reached the server). Run Check for Updates / Update Now again after this release; this time the log should read '✅ Updated: includes/controllers/TradeController.php', not '⏭ Skipped (protected)'
